canonical_name: Clydebridge grid connection (potential data centre site)
summary: A 360MW gate 2 grid connection reported by APRS (citing NESO's Existing Agreements Register) for 'Clydebridge, just outside Glasgow' — presumed to relate to the former Clydebridge Steelworks area between Cambuslang and Rutherglen, South Lanarkshire. No planning application, pre-application notice, developer announcement or press coverage has been found; the site exists in the public record only as a grid connection agreement. No developer has been identified.
maturity_explanation: Only evidence is a reported 360MW gate 2 grid connection in NESO's Existing Agreements Register as relayed by APRS (page updated July 2026). PlanIt searches (2019-2026) across all authorities for 'Clydebridge' and South Lanarkshire data centre keywords found no planning record; no developer or press attribution found.

latest_development.headline: APRS data centre map (updated 29 July 2026) lists Clydebridge 360MW among five gate 2 connection sites 'not otherwise seen elsewhere'

unknowns: The NESO Existing Agreements Register row itself (connectee name, connection site, agreement date, connection date) has not been independently extracted; the 360MW figure rests on APRS's reading of the register.

Whether the connection actually relates to the former Clydebridge Steelworks site (Cambuslang/Rutherglen) or another location branded 'Clydebridge' — and whether it is for a data centre at all rather than another demand user or a BESS.
No developer or connectee has been identified. The commissioning brief suggested Apatura as a presumption, but neither APRS nor any located source attributes Clydebridge to Apatura or anyone else.
Land ownership and status of the former steelworks land (long associated with Liberty Steel/Gupta group entities) is unconfirmed.
No planning activity of any kind was found (no PAN, screening, scoping or application).
Whether the reported 360MW is transmission entry capacity, demand capacity, or another register quantity.
